en: ...Did you have a request for me?

I am scheduled to assist Miu with
her invention.

I can fulfill your request afterward, provided
you do not mind waiting, of course.
<CLT=cltMIND>Should I hang out with Kirumi for a while?

Yes... I should rest for a bit before I help
her with the invention.
<CLT=cltMIND>Kirumi and I took a break together.
<CLT=cltMIND>Kirumi and I grew a little closer today.
